'''Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7''' was an underground complex located in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was a secret research facility run by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] constructed around an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] cave to study the artifcats hidden within. However an [[The Imprisoned One|ancient Rakatan mind]] took control of the facility, transforming the personnel into [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] slaves.

==History==
Decades before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the division was established on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to investigate an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] cave. A [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison|mind prison]] found in the cave got designated as a type-seven device - presumed to be capable of killing all life on a planet. Several other lesser relics were discovered and studied at the facility.<ref name="Cz found" />

The division was led by director [[Yem Antayen]], and his team included [[Doctor/Legends|Doctors]] [[Di-go]], [[Lerek]] and [[Soprin]]. Doctor Soprin was in charge of cataloging the artifacts, and together with Doctor Lerek she closely studied the [[mind prison]], hoping to discover its origin, not knowing of its true purpose and of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[The Imprisoned One|prisoner]] within. The scan revealed that the artifacts were more then 20.000 years old, and different theories of their creation were proposed among the scientists. While Soprin believed the relics are of [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] origin, Lerek was confident that they were made by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], less explored at the time. He also noticed that energy readings of the mind prison kept fluctuating, appearing as if it was trying to link with the lesser artifacts. Fearing for the team's safety, he took one of the lesser relics and left the division.<ref name="Cz found" />

Lerek's concerns with the danger posed by the [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison|mind prison]] were heard by director [[Yem Antayen]], who implemented a new safety policy, limiting physical access to the device. Despite this, when Doctor [[Soprin]] used a remote arm in attempt to open the mind prison, their equipment malfunctioned and the [[The Imprisoned One|One Imprisoned]] within the mind prison managed to connect with lesser artifacts and use them to start transforming everyone inside the facility into his puppets. Yem Antayen initiated a lock down procedure, and [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] security officers were ordered to seal the facility. Yem himself was killed by Rakatan's puppets, but one of the security officers - [[Grommik Kurthson]] - managed to seal the compound and escape, becoming the only survivor of the incident.<ref name="Cz found" />

[[The Imprisoned One]] augmented his new army of walking dead with [[Nanotechnology/Legends|nano-technology]] of his own design, and remained inside of the facility for decades, while his puppets constructed machines for mass replication of droids and augmentation of even more corpses.<ref name="Cz found" />

===Rediscovery===
Decades later, at the height of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3643 BBY]], the compound was rediscovered by several parties searching for old [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] secrets. Logs left by the research team and locked in data relays scattered across the [[Dune Sea/Legends|desert]], revealed the base's exact location and entry codes to an Imperial individual working with the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], and to an associate of [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Fauler]], as well as a rogue [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] official [[Gayem Leksende]] who was following Fauler's associate.<ref name="Cz found" />

{{GameMechanics|option=1}}
[[Fauler]]'s associate and [[Gayem Leksende]] found the base first; inside the facility they had a confrontation in which Gayem was killed. Fauler's associate deemed the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison|relic]] to dangerous and attempted to destroy it, leaving the compound believing to have succeeded. Rakatan technology however self-repaired, and was soon found again by an individual sent by the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]]. They decided to take the mind prison with them, delivering it to the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]].<ref name="Cz found" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Czerka complex was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Originally, the in game facility was much larger, and had a bonus objective which ended with fighting Director [[Yem Antayen]]. However, with the release of ''Knights of the Fallen Empire,'' the map was shrunk down significantly, and Antayen became a generic enemy who can be fought before entering the phased area.{{Fact}}

In the final mission of the planetary quest-chain of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Republic players are given the option of destroying the mind prison to stop [[the Imprisoned One]] (light side), or giving it to a rogue Czerka agent for profit (dark side). Empire players can also destroy the mind prison (light side) or turn it over to the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] for exploitation (dark side).<ref name="Cz found" /> This article assumes that both factions chose the option of their respective allignment.
